{{Top}}
[[File:Rebel_Commodore.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A Rebel Alliance commodore]]
{{Youmay|senior Navy officers|[[The Commodore]], the head of the [[BloodScar]] pirate gang}}
{{Quote|Commodore, eh? Does that come with a hat?|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Shield of Lies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>}}
The term '''commodore''' typically denoted senior Navy officers commanding groups of ships rather than individual vessels, but it was used in a number of different ways by various military hierarchies.

Most typically, the title "commodore" was associated with a distinct rank between [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and [[Rear Admiral/Legends|Rear Admiral]]; officers of this rank might serve as senior captains of important ships, or else could command flotillas, squadrons, or task forces, usually under superior flag officers.

This rank was in use in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]].<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

This usage of the term was established in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] rank hierarchies. In the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] the commodore was the commander of a "Squadron", leading 12-64 vessels.<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> [[Yat-De Viedas]] was a Rebel commodore during the early years of the Alliance; later, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] used this title. For example, during the [[Swarm War]] ([[35 ABY/Legends|35]]-[[36 ABY]]), Gavin Darklighter commanded a task force in the [[Fifth Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Fifth Fleet]] with the rank of commodore. However, the New Republic also accorded a separate title of "commodore" to some very high-ranking officers, such as [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who was so styled when he was appointed as commander of the entire [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|Fifth Fleet]] in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].

Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], in contrast, the rank between [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Line Captain]] and Rear Admiral had been [[Commander/Legends|commander]], and the term "commodore" was used instead as an alternate title for a [[Systems admiral|Systems Admiral]], a mid-ranking command officer within the Navy hierarchy of a [[Sector Group/Legends|Sector Group]], or an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] for a standard fleet.

Other military forces used the term "commodore" in different ways; for instance, the [[Utapau Skyforce/Legends|Utapau Skyforce]] had a rank of [[Air Commodore/Legends|Air Commodore]], the [[Home Guard Commodore]] commanded the [[Sullustan Home Guard/Legends|Sullustan Home Guard]], and [[The Commodore|the head]] of the [[BloodScar]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] took the title.
